title: Who I Am?
content: I'm someone who enjoys exploring the way things work—from the tiniest patterns in nature to the biggest ideas in science and creativity. Curiosity is a huge part of my identity, and I’m always drawn to things that challenge me or open up new ways of thinking.

title: What Drives Me?
content: I value learning, honesty, and independence. I tend to chase depth over surface-level trends, and I like building things that reflect who I am or solve a problem that matters to me. If something feels meaningful, I’m all in.

title: How I See the World?
content: I believe in mixing creativity with logic. I'm not someone who settles for “just good enough”—I enjoy going deeper, even if it takes more time. Whether it's helping someone understand a tough idea or figuring out why something isn’t working, I enjoy clarity and truth.
